name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search for Claude Code. Learns from your coding sessions and automatically surfaces relevant strategies, code snippets, APIs, and pitfalls as you work. v8.0.1. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.311, ace-cli >= 4.4.0 (pinned in package.json; @ace-sdk/core >= 3.8.0), Python >= 3.10 for the fallback hooks. Windows not supported (WSL2 works). Full changelog: https://github.com/ce-dot-net/ce-ai-ace/releases
